dct_title_s: Description de la partie des Indes Orientales qui est sous la domination du grand Mogol
dct_alternative_sm: Description de la partie des Indes Orientales qui est sous la domination du grand Mogol
dct_description_sm: First French edition of William Baffin's [1617-1619?] map of the Mughal Empire, including northern India. Extends from Afghanistan and Kashmir in the north into the Deccan Plateau in the south, and from the mouths of the Indus River in the east to Myanmar in the west--From dealer description.; Relief shown pictorially.; Includes scale bar in "Milles Anglois" (100 miles = approximately 4.75 cm).; Includes pictorial representation of cities as well as some vegetation and terrain.; Includes a cartouche in the upper right corner showing the symbol of the Mughal Empire, featuring a lion in repose in front of a rising sun, labeled "Les Armes ou Lesceau des Roys Moguls". Below the cartouche is the seal of the Mughal Emperor Jahangir, featuring roundels bearing his name and those of his eight dynastic predecessors--From dealer description.; "Avec privilege du Roy"--Lower right corner of map.; Title from semicircular cartouche at top center.; Map plate from: Relations de divers voyages curieux, qui n'ont point esté publiées; ou qui ont esté traduites d'Hacluyt, de Purchas, & d'autres voyageurs anglois, hollandois, portugais, allemands, espagnols; et de quelques Persans, Arabes, et autres auteurs orientaux. Enrichies de figures de plantes non décrites, d'animaux inconnus à l'Europe & de cartes geographiques de pays dont on n'a point encore donné de cartes. Premiere partie. Paris : Jacques Langlois, 1663.
